title: My Friend Dahmer
author: Derf Backderf
current_text: In 2021, My Friend Dahmer was removed as an option from a high school reading list in Leander, Texas; the decision was later reversed, and the book became available again on the condition that students receive counseling on its content. An elementary school parent asked the Catawba County schools to remove My Friend Dahmer.

sources.quote: My Friend Dahmer has been challenged multiple times, most notably in 2021, when it was removed as an option from a high school reading list in Leander, Texas.
sources.title: Adding My Friend Dahmer to Your Library or Classroom Collection – Comic Book Legal Defense Fund

sources.quote: Eventually, they reversed the decision, and the book was available again with the requirement that students receive counseling on the content within the graphic novel.
sources.title: Adding My Friend Dahmer to Your Library or Classroom Collection – Comic Book Legal Defense Fund

sources.quote: An elementary school parent asked the Catawba County schools to remove 24 books, including “My Friend Dahmer” by John Backderf. The graphic novel tells the story of Backderf’s teenage friendship with Jeffery Dahmer, who would later be convicted of 16 murders.
sources.title: John Backderf's 'My Friend Dahmer' and other titles might be banned from school libraries | Ideastream Public Media
